entries.title: Matthew 21:1
segments: And when they drew near Jerusalem, and had come to Bethphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

entries.title: Matthew 21:2
segments: saying to them, Go into the village across from you. And immediately you will find an ass tied, and a colt with her. Untie [them] and bring [them] to Me.

entries.title: Matthew 21:3
segments: And if anyone says anything to you, you shall say, The Lord has need of them, and immediately He will send them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:4
segments: All this was done so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 21:5
segments: "Tell the daughter of Zion, Behold, your King comes to you, meek, and sitting on an ass, even a colt the foal of an ass."

entries.title: Matthew 21:6
segments: And the disciples went and did as Jesus commanded them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:7
segments: And they brought the ass, even the colt, and put their clothes on them, and He sat on them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:8
segments: And a very great crowd spread their garments in the way. Others cut down branches from the trees and spread [them] in the way.

entries.title: Matthew 21:9
segments: And the crowds who went before, and those who followed, cried out, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed [is] He who comes in [the] name of [the] Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

entries.title: Matthew 21:10
segments: And when He had come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

entries.title: Matthew 21:11
segments: And the crowd said, This is Jesus the prophet, from Nazareth of Galilee.

entries.title: Matthew 21:12
segments: And Jesus went into the temple of God and cast out all those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money-changers, and the seats of those who sold doves.

entries.title: Matthew 21:13
segments: And He said to them, It is written, "My house shall be called the house of prayer"; but you have made it a den of thieves.

entries.title: Matthew 21:14
segments: And the blind and the lame came to Him in the temple, and He healed them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:15
segments: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things which He did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David, they were angry.

entries.title: Matthew 21:16
segments: And they said to Him, Do you hear what these say? And Jesus said to them, Yes, have you never read, "Out of [the] mouth of babes and sucklings You have perfected praise?"

entries.title: Matthew 21:17
segments: And leaving them, He went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.

entries.title: Matthew 21:18
segments: And returning early to the city, He hungered.

entries.title: Matthew 21:19
segments: And seeing a fig tree in the way, He came [to] it and found nothing on it except leaves only. And He said to it, let no fruit grow on you forever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.

entries.title: Matthew 21:20
segments: And when the disciples saw, they marveled, saying, How quickly the fig tree has withered away!

entries.title: Matthew 21:21
segments: Jesus answered and said to them, Truly I say to you, If you have faith and do not doubt, you shall not only do [this miracle] of the fig tree, but also; if you shall say to this mountain, Be moved and be thrown into the sea; it shall be done.

entries.title: Matthew 21:22
segments: And all things, whatever you shall ask in prayer, believing, you shall receive.

entries.title: Matthew 21:23
segments: And when He had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to Him [as He was] teaching, and said, By what authority do you do these things? And who gave you this authority?

entries.title: Matthew 21:24
segments: And Jesus answered and said to them, I will also ask you one thing; which if you tell Me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

entries.title: Matthew 21:25
segments: The baptism of John, where was it from? From Heaven or from men? And they reasoned within themselves, saying, If we shall say, From Heaven, he will say to us, Why then did you not believe him?

entries.title: Matthew 21:26
segments: But if we shall say From men, we fear the people; for all consider John as a prophet.

entries.title: Matthew 21:27
segments: And they answered Jesus and said, We cannot tell. And He said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

entries.title: Matthew 21:28
segments: But what do you think? A man had two sons; and he came to the first and said, Son, go work in my vineyard today.

entries.title: Matthew 21:29
segments: He answered and said, I will not. But afterwards he repented and went.

entries.title: Matthew 21:30
segments: And he came to the second and said likewise. And he answered and said, I [go], sir; and did not go.

entries.title: Matthew 21:31
segments: Which of the two did the will of [his] father? They said to Him, The first. Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that the tax-collectors and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

entries.title: Matthew 21:32
segments: For John came to you in [the] way of righteousness, and you did not believe him. But the tax-collectors and the harlots believed him. And when you had seen [it], you did not repent afterwards so that you might believe him.

entries.title: Matthew 21:33
segments: Hear another parable. There was a certain housemaster who planted a vineyard and hedged it round about, and dug a winepress in it, and built a tower, and rented it to vinedressers, and went into a far country.

entries.title: Matthew 21:34
segments: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the vinedressers to receive its fruits.

entries.title: Matthew 21:35
segments: And the vinedressers took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

entries.title: Matthew 21:36
segments: Again he sent other servants, more than the first, and they did the same to them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:37
segments: But last of all he sent his son to them, saying, They will respect my son.

entries.title: Matthew 21:38
segments: But when the vinedressers saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and get hold of his inheritance.

entries.title: Matthew 21:39
segments: And taking him, they threw [him] out of the vineyard and killed [him].

entries.title: Matthew 21:40
segments: Therefore when the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those vinedressers?

entries.title: Matthew 21:41
segments: They said to Him, Bad men! He will miserably destroy them and will rent out [his] vineyard to other vinedressers who will give him the fruits in their seasons.

entries.title: Matthew 21:42
segments: Jesus said to them, Did you never read in the Scriptures, "The stone which the builders rejected, this One has become the head of [the] corner; this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes?"

entries.title: Matthew 21:43
segments: Therefore I say to you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you and given to a nation bringing out its fruits.

entries.title: Matthew 21:44
segments: And he who falls on this Stone shall be broken, but on whomever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

entries.title: Matthew 21:45
segments: And when the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that He spoke of them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:46
segments: But seeking to lay hands on Him, they feared the crowd, because they held Him for a prophet.
